subject: Planning Ahead for Your Children's University Fees
body:
Dear Ms. Chen,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to follow up regarding the upcoming university fees for your two children, which we understand will amount to SGD 420,000 and fall due on 1 January 2027.

Given this timeline, we believe it would be valuable to meet at your convenience to review your current arrangements and discuss how best to prepare for this commitment well in advance. This would allow us to ensure that your planning remains aligned with your family's goals as the date approaches.

Please let me know a few dates and times that would suit you, and I will be happy to arrange a meeting accordingly.

Thank you, and I look forward to speaking with you soon.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
